ISO Base Media File Format demuxer (Mp4Reader), AAC audio only.

Ports symphonia-format-isomp4 demuxer/stream/atoms for the AAC-in-MP4 subset: top-level scan (ftyp/moov required, mdat break), box walk with 32-deep nesting cap, mvhd/tkhd/mdhd/hdlr, edit lists (parsed, not applied), stbl sample tables (stsd/stts/stsc/stsz/stco|co64; ctts/stss skipped), esds descriptor chain (OTI + AudioSpecificConfig) with mp4a sample entries, timescale timing, eager packet index with timestamp interleave, floor binary-search seek. Deviations: in-memory with an eager packet index; fragmented streams (mvex/moof) are rejected as unsupported; edit lists are parsed but not applied (as in the reference, which ignores them for duration); only AAC audio tracks are exposed (video/MP3-in-MP4 tracks skipped); metadata (udta/meta/ilst) is skipped; wave-nested esds is not searched (ffmpeg writes plain esds).
